title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Specialist
desc: About Vanguard Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. Vanguard India Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. Role Summary The Quality Assurance Engineer, Specialist is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications through comprehensive functional and system testing. The role focuses on test planning, test-script development, application triage, defect identification, and validation across different testing scenarios while collaborating closely with development and product teams. Responsibilities Review requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts. Perform functional, system, integration, and end-to-end testing across applications. Execute regression, performance, accessibility, and time-dimensional testing to validate application quality and stability. Analyze test results, identify defects, document findings, and support effective resolution. Perform application triage to investigate issues, identify potential root causes, and coordinate with engineering teams. Validate APIs and application integrations using tools such as Postman or Bruno. Use knowledge of Java, Angular, Node.js, and SQL to support testing, troubleshooting, and defect analysis. Apply testing best practices throughout the software development lifecycle and contribute to continuous quality improvement. Maintain clear testing documentation and defect tracking using Jira and Confluence. Collaborate with developers and cross-functional teams to identify quality risks early and ensure reliable software releases. Qualifications and Skills Minimum 5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with expertise in automation and manual testing. Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, IT, or Software Engineering, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science. Strong experience in functional, system, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, and end-to-end testing. Experience writing and executing detailed test scripts, test cases, and test scenarios. Understanding of Java, Angular, Node.js, SQL, and API testing using Postman or Bruno. Experience with application triage, defect investigation, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. Knowledge of Cucumber and software testing best practices across the development lifecycle. Experience with Jira and Confluence for test management, defect tracking, and documentation. Exposure to test automation frameworks and automation testing is an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Location This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
